description: Sealed evaluation assets under eval/sealed/ must never be written by run code, role sessions, or ad-hoc commits — they are opened only by the gate at promotion time. This hook intercepts writes and commit operations that touch eval/sealed/** and blocks them with an explanation (spec requirement R4).
name: block-sealed-eval-writes

then.command: echo 'BLOCKED: eval/sealed/ is read-only outside the promotion gate (see .kiro/steering/product.md rule 4). If this is a legitimate promotion, run it through the gate so the access is recorded in the ledger.' && exit 1
